name: PRINCIPAL FINANCIAL GROUP, INC

overrides_applied.source: Form 10-K for fiscal year ended December 31, 2025 (filed 2026-02-18), Consolidated Statements of Cash Flows, investing activities line 'Net purchases of property and equipment': $(98.0) million for FY2025, with $(68.8) million for FY2024 and $(102.0) million for FY2023 in the same statement (all in $ millions)
overrides_applied.reason: DATA_GAP:capex — capex missing for fiscal year(s) 2023, 2024 and 2025 of the last 3 in EDGAR companyfacts under every candidate tag the engine reads; in fact no capex flow tag exists for this filer in companyfacts at all (verified directly: no PaymentsToAcquire* property/equipment concept), because the filer reports capex only as the net line above in its cash-flow statement. The engine applies this single FY2025 filing value to every missing period (all years in the history carry no filed capex tag); for FY2023 it understates true capex by $4.0M (true $102.0M) and for FY2024 it overstates it by $29.2M (true $68.8M, in the conservative direction of lowering that year's OE), each well under 1% of that year's conservative OE, and capex at this level is ~2% of FY2025 OCF — immaterial to the verdict either way. The figure is net of proceeds from sales of property and equipment, as presented by the filer.

fragility_flags: STALE_FY: latest fiscal year ended 9 months ago — check TTM/quarterly OE and consider --base-oe-ps override
BUYBACK_TAILWIND: share count shrinking 4.0%/yr — already credited via the growth adjustment
NI_OCF_DIVERGENCE: net income and operating cash flow differ by >40% in 2023, 2024, 2025 — find the one-off (tax deposits, impairments, WC swings) before trusting the OE base
SECTOR_MODEL_MISMATCH: Finance sector — OE/capex DCF fits finance names poorly; grade confidence low

OVERRIDE_APPLIED:capex — filing gap in the last 3 FY filled by a judgment override (filing: Form 10-K for fiscal year ended December 31, 2025 (filed 2026-02-18), Consolidated Statements of Cash Flows, investing activities line 'Net purchases of property and equipment': $(98.0) million for FY2025, with $(68.8) million for FY2024 and $(102.0) million for FY2023 in the same statement (all in $ millions)); an override never replaces a filed value — see overrides_applied and override_impact
WIDE_SCENARIO_SPREAD: super-bull IV is 4.5x super-bear IV — uncertainty is huge; confidence should not be high

override_impact.basis: engine-native normalized base (median of last 3 FY) and weighted IRR, DCF run both ways (zero-fill baseline vs with-override); a --base-oe-ps TTM base is excluded from both sides — its override effect shows in ttm.py output
